subject: DI01009011

h.en: BJT:PNP and NPN construction and action

body.en:
Definition

A bipolar junction transistor uses electron and hole transport through adjoining semiconductor regions to control collector current.

Classification / representative type

  • NPN and PNP are complementary structures;they are not interchangeable without reversing relevant polarities and drive.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Emitter is heavily doped for efficient carrier injection.
  2. Base is thin and relatively lightly doped to limit recombination.
  3. Collector geometry supports carrier collection,voltage and heat dissipation.
  4. BE and BC junctions share the base;the device is not equivalent to two independent back-to-back diodes.
  5. NPN has an N emitter,P base and N collector;PNP reverses these regions.
  6. Lead order depends on the package/part;the emitter arrow specifies conventional direction,not a universal pin order.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. In forward active,BE is forward biased and BC is reverse biased.
  2. For NPN,emitter electrons enter the base;some recombine and contribute to base current.
  3. Most injected carriers cross the thin base and are swept into the collector.
  4. Terminal current continuity gives IE=IC+IB for magnitudes in the usual active convention.
  5. PNP uses hole injection with opposite voltage/current polarities;its emitter arrow points toward the base.
  6. Bias and temperature set the operating point;excess junction heat or voltage can destroy the transistor.

Applications

Amplification,low-voltage switching and electronic control.

Limitations and safety

NPN arrow points out;PNP points in.Do not assume beta is fixed or that swapping collector/emitter preserves rated performance.

Is beta the voltage gain of a CE stage?

No.Stage voltage gain also depends on bias,load and feedback.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Bipolar junction transistor adjoining semiconductor regionsમાં electron/hole transportથી collector current નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • NPN તથા PNP complementary structures છે;relevant polarities/drive બદલ્યા વગર interchange ન થાય.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Emitter efficient carrier injection માટે heavily doped છે.
  2. Base recombination ઘટાડવા thin તથા relatively lightly doped છે.
  3. Collector geometry carrier collection,voltage તથા heat dissipationમાં મદદ કરે છે.
  4. BE તથા BC junctions base share કરે છે;device બે independent back-to-back diodes સમાન નથી.
  5. NPNમાં N emitter,P base,N collector છે;PNPમાં regions reverse થાય છે.
  6. Lead order package/part મુજબ બદલાય છે;emitter arrow conventional direction બતાવે છે,universal pin order નહિ.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Forward activeમાં BE forward અને BC reverse biased છે.
  2. NPNમાં emitter electrons baseમાં આવે છે;થોડા recombine થઈ base currentમાં ફાળો આપે છે.
  3. મોટાભાગના injected carriers thin base પાર કરીને collectorમાં swept થાય છે.
  4. Usual active magnitude conventionમાં terminal continuityથી IE=IC+IB મળે છે.
  5. PNPમાં hole injection તથા opposite voltage/current polarities છે;emitter arrow base તરફ છે.
  6. Bias તથા temperature operating point નક્કી કરે છે;વધુ junction heat/voltage transistorને નષ્ટ કરી શકે છે.

ઉપયોગ

Amplification,low-voltage switching તથા electronic control.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

NPN arrow બહાર,PNP અંદર છે.Beta fixed છે અથવા collector/emitter swapથી rated performance same રહે એવું ન માનો.

Beta CE Stageનો Voltage Gain છે?

ના.Stage voltage gain bias,load તથા feedback પર પણ આધારિત છે.

h.en: PNP conduction:do not reuse NPN polarities
h.gu: PNP Conduction:NPN Polarities ફરી ન લો

body.en:
Understand the idea

In a PNP active example,the emitter is more positive than the base and the collector-base junction is reverse biased.

Explanation and application

  • A hypothetical VE=5V,VB=4.3V,VC=2V gives VEB=0.7V and VCB=−2.3V;these are example node potentials,not readings.
  • Holes injected from the emitter cross the thin base;most are collected by the collector.Conventional emitter current enters the device.
  • For magnitude calculations,IE=IC+IB still applies,but signed terminal-current conventions must be stated consistently.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

PNP active exampleમાં emitter base કરતાં વધુ positive તથા collector-base junction reverse biased છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Hypothetical VE=5V,VB=4.3V,VC=2Vથી VEB=0.7V તથા VCB=−2.3V મળે છે.આ example node potentials છે,readings નહિ.
  • Emitterથી injected holes thin base પાર કરે છે;મોટાભાગના collector collect કરે છે.Conventional emitter current deviceમાં પ્રવેશે છે.
  • Magnitude calculationsમાં IE=IC+IB હજી લાગુ પડે છે,પણ signed terminal-current conventions consistent કહો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

For the usual forward-active low-leakage model,alpha=IC/IE and beta=IC/IB describe DC current ratios.

Explanation and application

  • Using IE=IC+IB gives beta=alpha/(1−alpha) and alpha=beta/(beta+1);alpha lies below unity in this model.
  • ICBO is collector-base reverse leakage with emitter open.ICEO is collector-emitter leakage with base open;measurement conditions matter.
  • With transport factor alpha_F,the simplified relation is IC=alpha_F IE+ICBO.In the corresponding constant-parameter model,ICEO≈(beta+1)ICBO.
  • The transport factor and measured total-current ratio are not exactly identical when leakage is significant.Do not use leakage formulas beyond their model.
  • Leakage rises strongly with junction temperature;bias stability and thermal design help prevent current/temperature positive feedback.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Usual forward-active low-leakage modelમાં alpha=IC/IE તથા beta=IC/IB DC current ratios બતાવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • IE=IC+IBથી beta=alpha/(1−alpha) તથા alpha=beta/(beta+1) મળે છે;આ modelમાં alpha unityથી ઓછો છે.
  • ICBO emitter open હોય ત્યારે collector-base reverse leakage છે.ICEO base open હોય ત્યારે collector-emitter leakage છે;measurement conditions મહત્વની છે.
  • Transport factor alpha_Fથી simplified relation IC=alpha_F IE+ICBO છે.Corresponding constant-parameter modelમાં ICEO≈(beta+1)ICBO.
  • Leakage significant હોય ત્યારે transport factor તથા measured total-current ratio exact same નથી.Leakage formulasને modelની બહાર ન વાપરો.
  • Junction temperatureથી leakage ખૂબ વધે છે.Bias stability તથા thermal design current/temperature positive feedback અટકાવવામાં મદદ કરે છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

First ignore leakage:alpha=0.98,IE=5mA.Then independently consider beta=100,ICBO=20nA in the simplified leakage model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. IC=0.98×5=4.9mA;IB=5−4.9=0.1mA;beta=4.9/0.1=49
  2. alpha=49/(49+1)=0.98
  3. ICEO≈(100+1)×20nA=2020nA=2.02microA

Interpretation and check

The two examples use different operating assumptions;do not combine their parameters as one measured transistor.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

પહેલાં leakage અવગણો:alpha=0.98,IE=5mA.પછી અલગથી simplified leakage modelમાં beta=100,ICBO=20nA લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. IC=0.98×5=4.9mA;IB=5−4.9=0.1mA;beta=4.9/0.1=49
  2. alpha=49/(49+1)=0.98
  3. ICEO≈(100+1)×20nA=2020nA=2.02microA

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

બે examplesની operating assumptions જુદી છે;તેના parametersને એક measured transistor તરીકે ન ભેળવો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

The emitter is the reference common to the input base-emitter and output collector-emitter circuits;common does not necessarily mean protective earth.

Explanation and application

  • Input characteristic:IB versus VBE with VCE held fixed;it resembles a forward junction curve but depends on transistor conditions.
  • Output characteristic:IC versus VCE for several fixed IB values.Mark cutoff,saturation,active and breakdown boundaries qualitatively.
  • In active operation,the curves are not perfectly flat.Early effect and device limits make an ideal current-source model approximate.
  • Cutoff has negligible drive and leakage-level current.Saturation normally has both junctions forward biased and low VCE.
  • For small increments at a specified bias,input resistance≈Delta VBE/Delta IB and output resistance≈Delta VCE/Delta IC under their respective held-variable conditions.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Emitter input BE તથા output CE circuits માટે common reference છે;common એટલે protective earth જરૂરી નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Input characteristic:VCE fixed રાખીને IB versus VBE;forward-junction curve જેવી છે,પણ transistor conditions પર આધારિત છે.
  • Output characteristic:જુદા fixed IB માટે IC versus VCE.Cutoff,saturation,active તથા breakdown boundaries qualitatively ઓળખો.
  • Active operationમાં curves perfect flat નથી.Early effect તથા limitsથી ideal current-source model approximate બને છે.
  • Cutoffમાં drive negligible તથા leakage-level current છે.Saturationમાં સામાન્ય રીતે બંને junctions forward અને VCE low છે.
  • Specified bias નજીક input resistance≈Delta VBE/Delta IB તથા output resistance≈Delta VCE/Delta IC respective held-variable conditions સાથે મળે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Sweep VBE with current limiting while maintaining the assigned VCE;record IB at each actual point.

Explanation and application

  • The base supply must not become an uncontrolled forward-junction current source.
  • Use sufficiently small steps near the steep part of the characteristic and remain within ratings.
  • For a local slope,use neighbouring points around the stated Q point;do not label VBE/IB as the incremental slope.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Assigned VCE જાળવી current limiting સાથે VBE sweep કરીને દરેક actual pointએ IB નોંધો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Base supply uncontrolled forward-junction current source ન બને.
  • Steep part નજીક sufficiently small steps લો અને ratingsમાં રહો.
  • Local slope માટે stated Q point નજીકના points લો;VBE/IBને incremental slope ન કહો.

h.en: DC load line and Q point
h.gu: DC Load Line અને Q Point

body.en:
Understand the idea

The quiescent point is the transistor DC operating condition with the input signal set to zero,not necessarily with supply disconnected.

Explanation and application

  • For a grounded emitter with RC,VCE=VCC−IC RC.The cutoff intercept is VCC and the ideal saturation-axis intercept is VCC/RC.
  • With an emitter resistor,include IE RE in the loop;do not blindly reuse the grounded-emitter intercept relation.
  • A useful amplifier Q point lies in the active region with enough excursion before cutoff/saturation;midpoint is a design approximation,not a universal rule.
  • The DC load line and AC signal load line can differ because coupling/bypass capacitors alter AC paths.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Quiescent point input signal zero હોય ત્યારે DC operating condition છે;supply disconnected હોવું જરૂરી નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Grounded emitter તથા RC માટે VCE=VCC−IC RC.Cutoff intercept VCC અને ideal saturation-axis intercept VCC/RC છે.
  • Emitter resistor હોય તો loopમાં IE RE ઉમેરો;grounded-emitter relation blindly ન વાપરો.
  • Useful amplifier Q point active regionમાં હોય તથા cutoff/saturation પહેલાં પૂરતો excursion આપે;midpoint design approximation છે,universal rule નહિ.
  • Coupling/bypass capacitors AC paths બદલતાં DC તથા AC signal load lines જુદી હોઈ શકે છે.

h.en: CE voltage amplifier:DC stability and AC signal
h.gu: CE Voltage Amplifier:DC Stability અને AC Signal

body.en:
Definition

A biased CE stage converts a small base-emitter signal into a larger collector voltage variation using power from the DC supply.

Classification / representative type

  • This is a small-signal resistively loaded CE stage,not every possible amplifier class or power-amplifier design.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. BJT operates at a chosen active DC Q point.
  2. R1,R2 form the base-bias divider;its loading must be considered.
  3. RE provides DC negative feedback against emitter-current changes.
  4. RC converts collector-current variation to a collector-voltage variation.
  5. Input/output coupling capacitors block DC between stages while passing an intended AC band.
  6. An optional emitter bypass capacitor changes AC degeneration;RL and source resistance also influence gain.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Find the DC Q point with coupling/bypass capacitors treated as open in steady DC.
  2. A small positive input change raises VBE in the NPN example.
  3. Collector current rises within the small-signal active range.
  4. The increased RC drop lowers collector voltage,producing inversion.
  5. Output coupling removes the collector DC level from the following load.
  6. Excess input or poor bias causes clipping;check both waveform shape and DC conditions.

Applications

Sensor and audio-frequency voltage amplification within the designed band.

Limitations and safety

Gain depends on Q point,load,frequency and degeneration.Beta is current gain,not the stage voltage gain.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Biased CE stage DC supplyની powerથી small base-emitter signalને મોટા collector-voltage variationમાં ફેરવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • આ small-signal resistively loaded CE stage છે;દરેક amplifier class/power-amplifier design નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. BJT selected active DC Q point પર કામ કરે છે.
  2. R1,R2 base-bias divider બનાવે છે;loading ધ્યાનમાં લેવું પડે છે.
  3. RE emitter-current changes સામે DC negative feedback આપે છે.
  4. RC collector-current variationને collector-voltage variationમાં ફેરવે છે.
  5. Input/output coupling capacitors stages વચ્ચે DC block કરીને intended AC band pass કરે છે.
  6. Optional emitter bypass capacitor AC degeneration બદલે છે;RL/source R પણ gain બદલે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Steady DCમાં coupling/bypass capacitors open માની Q point શોધો.
  2. NPN exampleમાં small positive input change VBE વધારે છે.
  3. Small-signal active rangeમાં collector current વધે છે.
  4. વધેલો RC drop collector voltage ઘટાડે છે;આથી inversion મળે છે.
  5. Output coupling પછીના loadમાંથી collector DC level દૂર રાખે છે.
  6. Excess input/poor bias clipping કરે છે;waveform shape તથા DC conditions બંને તપાસો.

ઉપયોગ

Designed bandમાં sensor/audio-frequency voltage amplification.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Gain Q point,load,frequency તથા degeneration પર આધારિત છે.Beta current gain છે,stage voltage gain નહિ.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

A hypothetical midband CE stage has Vin=20mVrms and Vout=0.80Vrms with an inverted waveform.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Av≈−0.80/0.020=−40;magnitude=40
  2. Voltage gain in dB=20log10(40)=32.04dB

Interpretation and check

Do not mix peak,peak-to-peak and RMS values.The minus sign expresses phase inversion,not negative RMS magnitude.These are supplied example values,not observations.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Hypothetical midband CE stageમાં Vin=20mVrms તથા inverted Vout=0.80Vrms છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Av≈−0.80/0.020=−40;magnitude=40
  2. Voltage gain in dB=20log10(40)=32.04dB

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Peak,peak-to-peak તથા RMS ભેળવશો નહિ.Minus sign phase inversion બતાવે છે,negative RMS નહિ.આ supplied example values છે,observations નહિ.

body.en:
Understand the idea

In a simple grounded-emitter NPN stage,RB feeds the base from VCC and RC is in the collector path.

Explanation and application

  • Assuming active operation,IB≈(VCC−VBE)/RB,IC≈beta IB,VCE≈VCC−IC RC.
  • After calculating,verify the active-region assumption.The collector resistor can limit IC so that beta IB is no longer attainable.
  • Changes in beta,VBE and leakage move the Q point;the simplest fixed bias has weak thermal/device interchange stability.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Simple grounded-emitter NPN stageમાં RB baseને VCCથી feed કરે છે તથા RC collector pathમાં છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Active operation માની IB≈(VCC−VBE)/RB,IC≈beta IB,VCE≈VCC−IC RC.
  • Calculation પછી active-region assumption verify કરો.RC current limit કરતાં beta IB પ્રાપ્ત ન થઈ શકે.
  • Beta,VBE તથા leakage changes Q point બદલે છે;simple fixed biasની thermal/device interchange stability નબળી છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

The base resistor is fed from the collector rather than directly from a stiff VCC node.

Explanation and application

  • If collector current rises,the collector voltage falls;this reduces base drive and opposes the original rise.
  • RC may carry IC+IB in this topology,so keep the actual current path in KVL.
  • Feedback improves stability over simple fixed bias,but it does not eliminate parameter,temperature or load dependence.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Base resistor stiff VCC nodeના બદલે collectorથી feed થાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Collector current વધતાં collector voltage ઘટે છે;આથી base drive ઘટીને original riseનો વિરોધ થાય છે.
  • આ topologyમાં RCમાં IC+IB હોઈ શકે છે;KVLમાં actual current path જ લો.
  • Simple fixed bias કરતાં stability સુધરે છે,પણ parameter,temperature/load dependence સંપૂર્ણ દૂર નથી થતી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A rise in IE increases VE across RE;with a sufficiently stable base reference,this reduces VBE and opposes the current rise.This is DC negative feedback.

Explanation and application

  • Divider unloaded voltage:VTH=VCC R2/(R1+R2),RTH=R1||R2.
  • For the active constant-beta model,IB=(VTH−VBE)/[RTH+(beta+1)RE].Then IE=(beta+1)IB.
  • VB≈VTH is valid only when base loading is small relative to divider current.Use the loaded equation when necessary.
  • RE improves DC stability but reduces AC gain unless an appropriate bypass is provided;gain/stability are design tradeoffs.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

IE વધતાં RE ઉપર VE વધે છે;stable base reference હોય તો VBE ઘટીને current riseનો વિરોધ થાય છે.આ DC negative feedback છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Divider unloaded voltage:VTH=VCC R2/(R1+R2),RTH=R1||R2.
  • Active constant-beta modelમાં IB=(VTH−VBE)/[RTH+(beta+1)RE].પછી IE=(beta+1)IB.
  • Base loading divider current કરતાં નાનું હોય ત્યારે જ VB≈VTH યોગ્ય છે.જરૂર પડે loaded equation લો.
  • RE DC stability સુધારે છે,પણ યોગ્ય bypass વિના AC gain ઘટાડે છે;gain/stability design tradeoffs છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Adding RE to a fixed-base-resistor circuit provides local DC negative feedback without creating a two-resistor base divider.

Explanation and application

  • In the active constant-beta model,IB≈(VCC−VBE)/[RB+(beta+1)RE].
  • Use IE=(beta+1)IB and include both IC RC and IE RE when finding VCE.
  • RE reduces sensitivity but does not make beta,temperature or leakage irrelevant;validate the active-region assumption.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Fixed-base-resistor circuitમાં RE ઉમેરવાથી two-resistor base divider બનાવ્યા વિના local DC negative feedback મળે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Active constant-beta modelમાં IB≈(VCC−VBE)/[RB+(beta+1)RE].
  • VCE શોધતાં IE=(beta+1)IB લઈને IC RC તથા IE RE બંને ઉમેરો.
  • RE sensitivity ઘટાડે છે,પણ beta,temperature/leakage irrelevant નથી થતા;active-region assumption validate કરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

VCC=12V,R1=47kohm,R2=10kohm,RE=1kohm,RC=2kohm,beta=100,VBE=0.7V.Assume forward active and neglect leakage.

Step-by-step solution

  1. VTH=12×10/57=2.10526V;RTH=47×10/57=8.24561kohm
  2. IB=(2.10526−0.7)/(8.24561+101×1)=0.0128633mA
  3. IC=1.28633mA;IE=1.29920mA;VE=1.29920V
  4. VC=12−1.28633×2=9.42733V;VCE=8.12814V

Interpretation and check

VC exceeds VB≈1.99920V,so BC remains reverse biased in the assumed NPN active case.Check transistor dissipation and actual component tolerances before building.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

body.en:
Definition

A switching transistor is deliberately driven between cutoff and a suitable low-voltage ON state rather than kept linear for amplification.

Classification / representative type

  • Low-side NPN switching is shown.PNP high-side arrangements require different polarity and drive references.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Emitter is connected to the circuit common.
  2. Load connects from the positive supply to the collector.
  3. RB limits base input current from the controller or signal source.
  4. A base-emitter pull-down can prevent unintended turn-on from a floating drive.
  5. An inductive load needs correctly polarised,rated transient suppression.
  6. Choose collector current,voltage,thermal and base-drive ratings for the actual load.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. With insufficient forward base drive,the transistor is OFF except leakage.
  2. The collector output is pulled toward supply through a valid load path.
  3. Applied drive sends base current through RB.
  4. Sufficient drive brings the BJT into saturation for the intended load;VCE stays small but nonzero.
  5. Removing drive ends conduction after stored charge is removed;switching is not infinitely fast.
  6. Inductive turn-off energy follows the suppression path,not an uncontrolled collector-voltage spike.

Applications

LED/relay-driver stages and digital interfacing within component and source limits.

Limitations and safety

Use forced beta for design,not optimistic small-signal beta.Never assume an arbitrary GPIO can supply the chosen current or tolerate the supply voltage.

વ્યાખ્યા

Switching transistorને linear amplificationમાં રાખવાને બદલે cutoff તથા suitable low-voltage ON state વચ્ચે drive કરાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Low-side NPN દર્શાવ્યું છે.PNP high-sideમાં polarity તથા drive references જુદા જોઈએ.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Emitter circuit common સાથે જોડાય છે.
  2. Load positive supplyથી collector સાથે જોડાય છે.
  3. RB controller/signal sourceથી base current limit કરે છે.
  4. Base-emitter pull-down floating driveથી unintended turn-on અટકાવી શકે છે.
  5. Inductive load માટે correct polarity તથા rated transient suppression જોઈએ.
  6. Actual load માટે collector current,voltage,thermal/base-drive ratings પસંદ કરો.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. પૂરતી forward base drive ન હોય ત્યારે leakage સિવાય transistor OFF છે.
  2. Valid load path મારફતે collector output supply તરફ pull થાય છે.
  3. Applied drive RB મારફતે base current આપે છે.
  4. પૂરતી drive intended load માટે saturation લાવે છે;VCE નાનું પણ nonzero છે.
  5. Drive દૂર થતાં stored charge દૂર થયા પછી conduction બંધ થાય છે;switching infinitely fast નથી.
  6. Inductive turn-off energy suppression pathમાં જાય,uncontrolled collector spikeમાં નહિ.

ઉપયોગ

Component/source limitsમાં LED/relay-driver તથા digital interfacing.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Designમાં forced beta લો,optimistic small-signal beta નહિ.Arbitrary GPIO chosen current/voltage સહન કરે એવું ન માનો.

h.en: CE versus CB and CC:activity support

body.en:
Understand the idea

The theory emphasis is CE;the suggested chart activity can compare configurations qualitatively under appropriate active-region conditions.

Explanation and application

  • CE:emitter common,current gain approximately beta and normally inverted collector voltage signal;impedances depend on bias/load.
  • CB:base common,current gain approximately alpha below unity and typically low input resistance;voltage gain can exceed unity.
  • CC:collector common,emitter-follower voltage gain usually below unity and noninverting,current gain approximately beta+1.
  • Present a labelled comparison chart rather than treating these qualitative properties as identical numerical specifications for every circuit.
Can a negative calculated VCE still justify the assumed active model?

No.Recheck regions and circuit constraints instead of blindly using beta IB.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Theoryનો ભાર CE પર છે;suggested chart activityમાં suitable active-region conditions માટે qualitative comparison કરી શકાય.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • CEમાં emitter common,current gain આશરે beta તથા સામાન્ય રીતે inverted collector signal છે;impedances bias/load પર આધારિત છે.
  • CBમાં base common,current gain આશરે alpha unityથી ઓછો તથા typical low input resistance છે;voltage gain unityથી વધી શકે છે.
  • CCમાં collector common,emitter-follower voltage gain સામાન્ય રીતે unityથી ઓછો/noninverting તથા current gain આશરે beta+1 છે.
  • દરેક circuit માટે same numerical specifications માનવાને બદલે labelled qualitative comparison chart બનાવો.
Negative VCE Calculation પછી Active Model માન્ય?

ના.Blindly beta IB લેવાને બદલે regions તથા circuit constraints ફરી તપાસો.

q.en: Why is voltage-divider bias more stable?

a.en: A suitably stiff base reference and emitter negative feedback reduce Q-point variation.
a.gu: યોગ્ય stiff base reference તથા emitter negative feedback Q-point variation ઘટાડે છે.

q.en: Is amplifier voltage gain equal to beta?
q.gu: Amplifier Voltage Gain Beta સમાન છે?

a.en: No.Voltage gain depends on transconductance,loads and feedback.
a.gu: ના.Voltage gain transconductance,loads તથા feedback પર આધારિત છે.

q.en: Why does a relay driver need suppression?

a.en: Stored inductive energy can otherwise create a damaging turn-off voltage.
a.gu: Stored inductive energy turn-off સમયે damaging voltage બનાવી શકે છે.
